objectives: Capturar fechas, horas, lugares y condiciones en anuncios.
Distinguir lo que cambia de lo que se mantiene.
Responder preguntas de detalle e inferencia en 3 anuncios.

words: to send a file to a website

videos.search: TOEFL listen to an announcement practice

segments.text: Good afternoon, students. This is a reminder that the Student Services office will close early on Friday, at one o'clock instead of five, because of staff training. If you need to submit documents for your residence permit, please do so before Thursday evening. Also, the free language exchange that usually meets on Fridays will be moved to Monday, same time, same room.

items.q: Why will the office close early on Friday?
By when should students submit residence-permit documents?
What is changing about the language exchange?
items.explain: Se mueve del viernes al lunes (misma hora y sala).

segments.text: Before we start today's class, a few reminders. Your group presentations will take place next Tuesday and Wednesday, and the order has been posted on the course website. Each group will have twelve minutes, followed by three minutes for questions. If a member of your group is absent, please inform me by email beforehand, since I can only reschedule in exceptional cases. And finally, remember that your slides must be uploaded by Monday midnight.

items.q: How long is each group's presentation, excluding questions?
What should students do if a group member will be absent?
options: Ask a classmate to replace him

items.q: What can be inferred about rescheduling?

segments.text: Welcome to the university library. Starting this semester, the third floor will be a silent study area, with no talking or phone calls permitted at any time. Group work should take place on the first floor or in the bookable rooms. The self-service machines now accept contactless payment, and the library's online catalog has been redesigned to make searching easier. If you have difficulty finding a source, our librarians are available every weekday from nine to five.

items.q: What is the new rule for the third floor?
When can students get help from librarians?
options: Every weekday from nine to five

quiz.explain: Anotar el cambio: 1 en lugar de 5.
